comment: Everything this project takes from elsewhere that is not an npm package. scripts/vendor.mjs fetches each entry at the pinned commit and refuses a file whose checksum differs. Change a pin, then run `npm run vendor -- --update` to record the new checksums.

cskburn.use: Compiled to WebAssembly for the Retevis C62 flasher (public/cskburn/).

website.use: The OpenRTX website's pages and pictures, copied into site/content/docs/ at build time by scripts/import-docs.mjs. Not committed here; each page's edit link goes to this repository.

device-mockups.svg.use: Radio drawings by Joshua Murphy (ranguli, VO1RFX): CS7000 and MD-380, and the style the other drawings follow.

screen-colour.png.use: What the screen of a colour-display radio shows in the drawings.

screen-mono.png.use: What the screen of a monochrome-display radio shows in the drawings.

tools.comment: Programs the checks run that do not come from npm. Downloaded once per machine into the cache.

cskburn.use: LISTENAI's own build of cskburn, which the command line runs for the Retevis C62 (cli/cskburn.ts). The release of the commit pinned above, so it is the same program the page runs as WebAssembly.

ports.comment: Code that was written by porting or following another project. Not fetched; recorded so a later change upstream can be compared. The commit is the upstream revision that was read.

src/flash/tyt.ts.note: The last revision with the C++ sources; upstream dropped them on 2026-11-02.

src/flash/gd77.ts.note: Copyright Roger VK3KYY. Used under GPL version 3 or later. radio_tool was a cross-reference.

src/sim/gd77.ts.note: Byte arrays copied from the loader; .sgl fixtures built the way bin2sgl.py (Copyright 2019 Kai Ludwig DG4KLU) does, with a stand-in cipher table.

src/flash/rt950.ts.note: Branch rt950pro. rt950_flash.py has no licence line of its own; the other two files and the project are GPL-3.0-or-later. The protocol was followed, not the code.

src/flash/dfu.ts.note: Two ideas only: reading the configuration descriptor by hand, and the grammar of the DfuSe memory-layout string. No code taken.

src/backup/tyt-stock.ts.note: Codeplug ranges of the other models from dmrconfig f9bc00c4abc5 (BSD-3-Clause) and qdmr fb9c96af53f6 (GPL-3.0-or-later).

src/backup/gd77-stock.ts.note: Also follows qdmr fb9c96af53f6 (GPL-3.0-or-later): lib/radioddity_interface.cc. Facts only from OpenGD77CPS, which has no licence.

src/backup/rt4d-stock.ts.note: Reply header check from radtel-rt-890-oefw ec8e053e8e3e (Apache-2.0), app/uart.c.

src/backup/rt950-stock.ts.note: The read path only: handshake, key packet, scrambling, block read, address map. docs/cps-uart.md describes a framed variant of the protocol; the tool, which this follows, sends raw bytes.

src/flash/cs7000-robot.ts.note: The OpenRTX-slot session only: frame layout, commands, SCSI vendor commands and the TORX table, which is copied. The code is not.
